131.news_title: LCD Arcade Marquee for your Arcade Machine
131.long_description: Arcooda has today released its most advanced LCD arcade marquee designed specifically for your Arcooda Game Wizard Xtreme, Taito Vewlix, and Chewlix arcade machines. Our 16.6 inch 1080P panel offers a plug and play metal framework with custom extension cables and controller allowing easy mounting in any arcade cabinet. Ideal for your arcade player instructions, header, and videos. Our 16.6 inch LCD Arcade Marquee with Monitor Side Panel allows you to add a second or third LCD monitor to your Arcooda Game Wizard Xtreme, Taito Vewlix or Chewlix arcade machines. Display your arcade headers, player instructions, or video animations with our Arcooda LCD arcade marquee panels. Arcooda LCD arcade marquees are designed for the arcade operator with plug and play function allowing you to display arcade graphics, headers, player instructions, game scores, advertising material, and 1080P animated videos. All can be controlled via the extension wiring and secondary button board which can be mounted in the metal frame at front of the machine (on all Game Wizard 3.0 machines). The 16.6inch LCD marquee is made with a full metal case, and has cable management mountings for easy handling of your mounted wires. The 16.6inch LCD arcade marquee is backward compatible for any Arcooda Game Wizard 1.0 and 2.0 arcade cabinets, and supports all new arcade machine models.
